title: Software Engineering Internship
description: A summer internship for students interested in building web and backend systems. Interns work alongside engineering teams on real projects and receive mentorship throughout the program.

title: NSBE National Convention
description: An annual convention bringing together thousands of Black engineering students and professionals for career fairs, workshops, and networking events.

title: Artificial Intelligence Research Fellowship
description: A research fellowship for undergraduates interested in machine learning and AI ethics. Fellows work directly with faculty mentors on ongoing research projects.

title: Freshman Engineering Scholarship
description: A merit-based scholarship for first-year engineering students demonstrating academic excellence and community involvement.

title: Cybersecurity Summer Analyst Program
description: A hands-on internship focused on threat detection, network security, and incident response for students pursuing careers in cybersecurity.

title: Data Science for Social Good Fellowship
description: A summer fellowship pairing student data scientists with nonprofit organizations to solve community-focused data challenges.

title: Product Management Rotational Program
description: A rotational internship exposing students to product strategy, user research, and cross-functional collaboration across product teams.

title: Graduate Research Assistantship in Robotics
description: A funded research assistantship for graduate students working on robotics and autonomous systems projects with faculty advisors.

title: Resume and Interview Prep Workshop Series
description: A multi-session workshop series covering resume building, technical interview preparation, and professional networking strategies.

title: Women and Minorities in STEM Scholarship
description: A scholarship supporting underrepresented students pursuing degrees in engineering, computer science, and related STEM fields.

title: Software Engineering Externship (Remote, Short-Term)
description: A short-term remote externship giving early-career students exposure to agile development practices at early-stage startups.

title: Regional Technology Leadership Conference
description: A one-day regional conference featuring talks and panels on technology leadership, career growth, and emerging industry trends.

title: Applied AI Research Program for Undergraduates
description: A structured summer research program pairing undergraduates with AI research groups working on applied machine learning problems.

title: Technical Communication and Public Speaking Bootcamp
description: A weekend bootcamp helping engineering students build confidence in technical writing, presentations, and public speaking.
